scope: Gem/soulstone sockets are separate from random-affix slots. No runtime or database equipment modified.

access.tutorialTrigger: First capital visit; typically around level 30, later if story entry is delayed
access.rank2Equipment: No natural sockets. Tutorial grants exactly one slot on one chosen weapon item and one slot on one chosen armor item; choices remain equipment-group-specific.

tutorialSocketGrant.scope: one chosen weapon item plus one chosen armor item

craftedAdditionalSlots.unlockStatus: Craftable extra confirmed; exact first equipment level not explicitly resolved

craftedAdditionalSlots.availability: Earlier high-end example; exact tier and unlock pending

itemCounting.gloves: One item for the pair, one shared natural socket, not one socket per hand
itemCounting.dualWield: Each one-hand weapon is its own item with its own slots
itemCounting.swordAndShield: Sword and shield each have one natural slot, each can receive one extra under the level-80+ smithing rule

primaryAttributes.equipment: all socketable equipment unless a later explicit restriction is defined

rules: Crafting adds to natural slots; do not count crafted sockets as natural sockets or add the same crafted slot twice.
Counts are capacities, not proof that the player owns or has filled every socket.
Earlier wording of a natural third level-100 chest socket is superseded: natural chest count remains two, crafting enables the third.
Earlier level-100 gloves increase is superseded: natural gloves count remains one; one craftable addition yields two for the pair.

sameStoneLimit.identity: Same stone type; rank variants must not bypass the per-type limit.
sameStoneLimit.capacityBasis: Number of unlocked usable sockets on this item; empty sockets still count toward capacity.

examples.bootsExample: One movement-speed stone is allowed in a boots socket.

examples.dualWield: Each one-hand axe may independently contain one strength stone and one different stone.
